content.short: Akash Network is an open source, decentralized cloud computing platform and P2P marketplace.
content.description: Akash Network, founded by Greg Osuri, is an open source, decentralized cloud computing platform. It operates as a peer-to-peer marketplace for cloud compute, enabling access to cloud resources at prices far lower than those of major providers. Often described as the Airbnb for cloud compute, Akash lets developers and organizations run workloads without relying on traditional centralized clouds, providing a cost-efficient and open alternative for cloud resources.
